selected_sources.role: Unsubmitted upstream draft: minimal IR/C reproducers, 9-row compiler matrix, BPFHasLoadAcqStoreRel hypothesis.
Confirms the load failure is separate from the RMW fix: PR 210371 does not fix generic/v3 loads.

patch_note: Separate issue with no patch: PR 210371 is the RMW fix, not a load fix. Any future load repair gets its own register record.
defect: A minimal aligned 64-bit monotonic atomic load aborts BPF instruction selection (Cannot select AtomicLoad) on generic/v3 across LLVM 18/21/22/23; v4 lowers it to an ordinary u64 load. The relaxed-load pattern sits inside the BPFHasLoadAcqStoreRel predicate, so disabling acq/rel also removes the plain load.
tier_note: Compiler-only reproductions; failing code never reaches the verifier. No kernel runtime claim.
